channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
item.description: Once the most valuable company in the world, Nvidia now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.

item.title: A massive bearish trade just happened in the chip stocks
item.description: Options traders place big bets that semiconductor stocks have further to fall

item.title: Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor
item.description: Cybersecurity companies have been hunting for acquisitions in the AI era.

item.title: The bull market has a new problem. The 'smart money' is selling
item.description: Companies are shifting from share buybacks to stock issuance, adding new supply. Anthropic’s $81 billion IPO puts that demand to the test.

item.title: Trump vows to stop U.S. companies from building data centers abroad, threatens 'tremendous tax'
item.description: Trump spoke at the White House after meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin for a historic trilateral summit in China.

item.title: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off
item.description: Odds that the S&P 500 will cross 8,000, which were once north of 70%, are extremely low on platform Kalshi.

item.title: As Anthropic shares tank, investors scramble to hedge. It could be very expensive
item.description: Anthropic options list Monday. They will likely be expensive

item.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Lutnick
item.description: President Donald Trump, when asked by CNBC's Eamon Javers, said he has not lost confidence in Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

item.title: Jensen Huang to testify publicly before Senate banking panel, Chairman Scott says
item.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has faced a flurry of criticism on Capitol Hill in the wake of his involvement with a suspected Chinese spy.

item.title: Data center construction costs soar 13% in 2026
item.description: The demand for large data centers in the U.S. this year, driven by AI needs, grew beyond the supply of powered land and the labor to build these structures.

item.title: Warsh wants Fed officials to talk less. Instead, they’re talking more
item.description: Fed officials have been rushing to the microphones lately while the Fed chairman stays on the sidelines.

item.title: Ex-GM CEO on Mary Barra succession planning: 'It's going to be tough'
item.description: Former GM CEO Dan Akerson says whoever replaces Mary Barra will have a difficult task because they'll inherit rapid change in technology and the auto industry.

item.title: Trump says he discussed Jensen Huang with Xi; Bessent tells CNBC Nvidia chip export policy is unchanged
item.description: Trump said he discussed Jensen Huang with China's Xi. Bessent said the ousted Nvidia CEO didn't come up in talks he had while in China.

item.title: Anthropic was supposed to save the AI trade. What went wrong?
item.description: Technology stocks tanked despite one of the most hotly anticipated tech IPOs in years. Why Anthropic couldn't revive AI animal spirits.

item.title: Gap names new Athleta CEO, says Old Navy turnaround is seeing signs of progress
item.description: Gap on Thursday announced Ashley Kechter as the new CEO of Athleta. The retailer also reported mixed fiscal third-quarter earnings.

item.title: Anthropic raises $93.5 billion total as underwriters scoop up ‘greenshoe’ overallotment
item.description: The AI company sold an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares at $83 per share in the record IPO.

item.title: Intensifying AI rout wipes out Nasdaq's 2026 gains. Alphabet is a tech bright spot
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch, an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Forget Anthropic: In Europe, the IPO hype is about a blue lagoon
item.description: Iceland’s famed Blue Lagoon geothermal spa is going public in a $110 million IPO, tapping investor interest in tourism and the booming wellness industry.

item.title: A wave of 'pent-up quits' could boost turnover in the job market, expert says: 'The labor market is a bit like a coiled spring'
item.description: Unhappy workers are staying put at their jobs as anxiety around the job market looms. If conditions improve, these workers could be the first to quit, according to experts.

item.title: Jensen Huang's — and Nvidia's — legal exposure balloons
item.description: "It's not going to get any better for Jensen Huang; it's going to get far worse," said Salvatore Graziano, a New York securities litigation attorney.

item.title: Bitcoin suffered identical sell-off pattern ahead of Anthropic, SpaceX IPOs — what happens next?
item.description: With Anthropic now public, investors are watching to see whether bitcoin and ether find a floor, and if institutional demand returns.

item.title: U.S.-China trade, Taiwan and tech tensions remain unresolved as Trump returns from Asia
item.description: Analysts note few concrete outcomes from the high-profile trilateral and other meetings for APEC in Shenzhen this week.

item.title: SpaceX’s subsidiary Cursor tells lawmakers it's considering phasing out Chinese AI models
item.description: SpaceX's Cursor is considering phasing out Chinese-developed open-weight AI models over geopolitical risk, according to a House report reviewed by CNBC.

item.title: A24 is having a great year at the box office. That could give HBO Max a streaming edge
item.description: A24 films "Backrooms," "The Drama" and the Elizabeth Holmes documentary, "You Can See Everything," are fueling a banner year at the box office.

item.title: Cathie Wood’s Ark Invest was a big buyer of Anthropic as she tells CNBC she’s ‘quite optimistic’
item.description: Wood's firm bought $90.8 million worth of Anthropic in six funds, according to a trade notification from the firm.

item.title: Bitcoin's regulation bull case is played out. What could drive crypto gains moving forward
item.description: Crypto investors are looking beyond Congress for the next catalyst after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act in September.

item.title: Rejecting cheap fabrics, higher prices: Why shoppers are asking for better clothes
item.description: Retailers are charging higher prices for clothing made with cheaper materials. Shoppers are taking notice and experts say it could shift how they spend.

item.title: Bitcoin sell-off: Crypto is failing the 'digital gold' test again as it sinks with stocks
item.description: Bitcoin’s sell-off is tracking risk assets again as experts weigh rates, ETF flows, politics and whether the crypto can function as a market hedge.

item.title: White House replaces cyber director Sean Cairncross amid widespread tech outages
item.description: Sean Cairncross will be replaced by Pentagon chief information officer Kirsten Davies.

item.title: Some FHA borrowers pay mortgage insurance for a decade or more. There's an industry push to change the rules
item.description: Mortgage industry groups want the rules applying to mortgage insurance for FHA loans to be changed to bring down the cost for borrowers.
